shared_elements: a horizontal row of repeated small figures
justification: Both surfaces show schematic animal or animal-like figures in profile and a roughly horizontal line of small repeated figures, but these are near-universal traits. A shows a dense, register-organised composition of large, specific creatures (crouching quadrupeds with big heads, a long-necked bird, a bird of prey with splayed wings, a human-like figure with arms) in relief and carefully stacked bands, while B shows only sparse, thin, stick-like painted marks scattered on an open surface with no comparable large creatures, registers or interactions.
